full_page.content:
1936, January
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 82 Cont.
Germain DeBecker - 15'2 - terrible convulsions - Ypsilanti
Jan.
Alice Sinz - 44 - "Unity" - has five children to take care of - fears operation. Enrolled - 50¢
Dave Martin - 50 - out of Church 10 yrs. Mother promised to come to dev. her ... if son returned ... now asks prayers of thanks ..... O.K.
8 Page 83
Jan. 9 Mrs. F. Fires - 32 - back from Sanitorium greatly improved - pray for continuation of health.
Remi Christians - Arlington - farmer lost near $100. in beer garden Suspects gypsies
Leo Kirschner of Toledo - 55 - anxious
Mrs. Anna Roman - 29 - has husband and two ... in doubt ... claims ... voices - spirits - etc
James Stambough - 4 - non C. spasms - very restless, sometimes in convulsions
Margaret Neal - 52 - Poor health ... fears she lifted something too heavy .
Ray Maloney - 39 - drinking, neglects family.
Mrs. Macey - wants girl to help - $10 per - room & board
Jas. Doran - 17 - very sick - 4 X-rays ... so far Drs, at sea. En- rolled to-night.
Page 84 Jan. John Camilrowicz - 31 - out of work 3 yrs - bad leg - Promises to go to Holy Com. weekly instead of bi monthly
Jack MacLean - 16 - ran away from home ... prayers ...
A. Dhont - 60 - Dec. 24 - dying of cancer - discouraged.
Thanks - Apend. broken - hopeless - from Sault Sainte Marie
